description: Get current trending tokens on Twitter. This tool identifies which cryptocurrencies and tokens are generating the most buzz on Twitter right now. The results include token names, their relative popularity, and sentiment indicators. Use this when you want to discover which cryptocurrencies are currently being discussed most actively on social media. Data comes from ELFA API and represents real-time trends.
